build_segment_dataset_module: build a StopesModule to segment DATASET audio folders into a single gzipped manifest file using VAD or SHAS
run_SegmentDATASETModule_array: run the array method to batch numbered dataset folders into Progress jobs for SLURM submission
run_SegmentDATASETModule_run: run the module to process mp3 files and write segmented audio timestamps to a gzipped output file
review_SegmentDATASETModule_checkpoint: review the checkpoint method that resubmits the module with updated progress for fault-tolerant execution
create_load_segmenter: create a segmenter callable from config that loads either VAD or SHAS model and returns a file segmentation function
